services.name: Bunkhouse Cafe
services.desc: Nestled on the historic grounds of the Claybank Brick Plant, the Bunkhouse Café offers visitors a warm, prairie welcome. Enjoy homemade meals, daily specials, and fresh baked goods in a cozy, rustic setting. Don’t miss the legendary Saskatoon berry pie-a local favorite and a sweet taste of Saskatchewan tradition. Whether you’re stopping in for lunch or just a coffee break, the Bunkhouse Café is the perfect place to relax and refuel during your visit.
